svg.title: ContextPilot full system architecture
svg.desc: Complete architecture showing the developer layer, compression pipeline, provider layer, telemetry flow, and dashboard tiers from individual to enterprise
svg.text: Anonymous telemetry (token counts, latency, scores only)
Security: No prompt/response data transmitted. TLS 1.3. AES-256 at rest. SOC 2 target (Phase 3).
Stack: Python 3.10+ \u2022 FastAPI \u2022 PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB \u2022 Redis \u2022 Next.js \u2022 Optional Rust via PyO3
